fields.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $28,000 for AmeriCorps classroom support at Oakland International High
fields.summary: Bay Area Community Resources will provide AmeriCorps staff at Oakland International High School to support instruction and learning in classes and the after-school program, including academic support, mentoring and tutoring for newly arrived immigrant students. The agreement runs September 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021 and pays up to $28,000, funded by the Oakland Fund for Children and Youth. A separate item on the same agenda (21-1176) covers a different AmeriCorps position focused on library and literacy work.

fields.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $14,000 for an AmeriCorps library and literacy position at Oakland International High
fields.summary: Bay Area Community Resources will provide an AmeriCorps staff person at Oakland International High School to support literacy development and student-led research through the school library and the after-school program, including academic support, mentoring and tutoring for newly arrived immigrant students. The agreement runs September 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021 and pays up to $14,000, funded by the Measure G parcel tax. A separate item on the same agenda (21-1175) covers a different AmeriCorps position focused on classroom support.
